market.question: Will bitcoin hit $1m before GTA VI?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trading near $77K on Apr 29, 2026 — needs ~13x to reach $1M before market deadline of Jul 31, 2026; effectively impossible. GTA VI delayed to Nov 19, 2026, after deadline. Per resolution rules, if neither event occurs by July 31, 2026, market resolves 50-50, so fair value is 0.50.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of unexpected GTA VI surprise release or extreme BTC rally before July 31, 2026
